messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for serve-prod-gpu-1: GPU memory pressure (CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED) — 12 occurrences in 2m. Rule: gpu.memory.pressure.high

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 created and notified oncall. Severity: P1. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

emma (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking — checking pool metrics and recent deploys.

raj (runtime): saw a spike in long-sequence requests around same time. Could be KV cache churn + fragmentation. Pulling logs.

emma (oncall): logs show repeated: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and `CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED: out of memory after retries`. Also a lot of small evictions, then a big OOM.

ops-bot: Autoshedder kicked in for queue serve-prod-high-prio at 14:12:05 UTC — dropped 6 requests.

emma (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) scale up gpu pool by +2 nodes (if capacity), 2) disable batching on model route `/v1/generate` for 60m, 3) drain the most loaded host. I'm applying 1 now.

raj (runtime): scaling attempt returned `quota_exceeded` for GPU quota in eu-west-1 — initiating fallback: spinning up CPU-backed fallback workers for low-priority routes.

marta (sre lead): tagging customers: check high-volume customers with long context usage — quick query on routing logs?

emma (oncall): querying: `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND seq_len>4096 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5` — top offenders: cust-tilt (120 reqs), cust-search (87 reqs). Notifying CS.

raj (runtime): adding temporary kernel-level limits: set `max_sequence=8192` -> but need to patch via config and reload workers. I'll push a hotfix to limit max_context for new sessions. Deploying now (rolling restart).

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by emma (oncall) at 14:13:22 UTC.

emma (oncall): rolling restart started on pool hosts: `serve-prod-gpu-1-{a,b}`. Using `kubectl rollout restart` on runtime service with graceful drain 30s.

ops-bot: drain completed on host serve-prod-gpu-1-a, evicted 34 tasks, rescheduled to CPU fallback.

raj (runtime): after restart, one host reported `nvml: GPU memory fragmentation detected` warnings. Kernel shows `large allocations failing despite free mem` — fragmentation suspected.

marta (sre lead): escalation recommended: bring in driver/runtime patch and offload KV cache to DRAM temporarily. Tom, can you take over if this continues?

tom (next-oncall): on it — standby. Also have a playbook step: `force-compact-kv-cache` on affected hosts. Do we have that tool ready?

raj (runtime): yes, running `./tools/kv_compact --pool serve-prod-gpu-1 --parallel 4`. Starting compaction now.

emma (oncall): customer-impact status: initial monitoring shows increased latency for long-sequence requests (p95 from 180ms -> 1.2s) and ~0.2% 5xxs from evictions. CS notified for cust-tilt and cust-search.

ops-bot: auto-scaler attempted scale at 14:15 but hit quota; scale request queued.

raj (runtime): compaction completed on 2 hosts, logs show reduced fragmentation warnings, `CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED` count dropped from 12 -> 2 in 10m.

marta (sre lead): good. Next steps: 1) file infra change to increase GPU headroom and request quota bump; 2) add runtime metric to detect fragmentation patterns earlier; 3) add a fallback policy to shift long-context requests to dedicated reserved capacity automatically.

emma (oncall): updating incident PD12345 notes with mitigation and customer impact. Marking as "under control" for now but leaving PD open until quota bump / autoscaler resolved.

pagerduty: PD12345 reassigned to tom (oncall) for follow-through.

tom (next-oncall): acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate quota request and follow up with runtime team tomorrow. If we see OOM spike again, escalate to infra on-call.

emma (oncall): thanks team — leaving final commands in channel:

```bash
# commands used during triage
kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -o wide | grep serve-prod-gpu-1
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-service --namespace=prod --selector=pool=serve-prod-gpu-1
./tools/kv_compact --pool serve-prod-gpu-1 --parallel 4
```

raj (runtime): adding note: we'll ship a small change to reduce initial KV cache warm-up allocations (PR #8421) — should reduce fragmentation risk for spikey workloads.

marta (sre lead): filing post-incident action items in SOP board: link: https://boards.example/INC-PD12345. Assigning owners: quota (cloud-team), metrics (runtime), fallback-policy (product).

emma (oncall): closing thread here for visibility. If anyone sees a recurrence, ping PD12345 and re-open. :white_check_mark:
